title: TreeSize / WizTree — What it is
description: TreeSize (JAM Software) and WizTree (Antibody Software) answer the most urgent question on an AI workstation: where did the disk space go? WizTree reads the NTFS Master File Table directly, scanning entire multi-terabyte drives in seconds; TreeSize adds scheduled scans, history and duplicate search. Both render treemaps and ranked folder lists so bloated caches, old checkpoints and forgotten datasets can be cleared with confidence. It is made by JAM Software / Antibody Software and runs on Windows.
